name: limit-band
description: Band above the prompt: 5-hour and 7-day limit with a countdown to the reset, the 5-hour countdown always, the 7-day limit above a threshold

threshold.title: Threshold in percent
threshold.description: The 7-day limit appears only when it is used at least this much (0 to 100). The 5-hour limit follows its own switch.

fiveHour.title: Always show 5-hour limit
fiveHour.description: Show the 5-hour limit with its reset countdown even below the threshold.

sevenDay.title: Show 7-day limit
sevenDay.description: Also show the 7-day limit when it is above the threshold.
